description.en: The instance ID of the DRDS instance.
The name of the source table.
The name of the target table.
The task type. Valid values: `SHARD_TO_SINGLE`, `SINGLE_TO_SHARD`, and `SHARD_TO_SHARD`.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun drds create-shard-task --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --drds-instance-id drds000000000000 --db-name test --source-table-name test_tb1 --target-table-name test_tb2 --task-type SINGLE_TO_SHARD --api-version 2019-01-23 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun drds CreateShardTask --region cn-hangzhou --SourceTableName test_tb1 --DrdsInstanceId drds000000000000 --TaskType SINGLE_TO_SHARD --DbName test --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --TargetTableName test_tb2
